CL-0110 · CLASS 7
Compare soap and detergent in hard water

Compare selected soap and neutral detergent in soft/hard water with equal-mole or equal-mass stock matching. Finite metering syringes, stopper closure, 120-second practical, four observation tables and 168 worked blocks per observation. Availability is not a washing-performance prediction.
